text:
Predicates:
InNewMexico(x) ::: x is in New Mexico.
InTexas(x) ::: x is in Texas.
MountainRange(x) ::: x is a mountain range.
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Donated(x) ::: x was donated.
HasMine(x) ::: x has a mine.
Premises:
MountainRange(picuris) ∧ (InNewMexico(picuris) ∨ InTexas(picuris)) ::: The Picuris Mountains are a mountain range in New Mexico or Texas.
Visited(juan, picuris) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
LocatedIn(hardingPegmatiteMine, picuris) ∧ Donated(hardingPegmatiteMine) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine, located in the Picuris Mountains, was donated.
¬∃x (MountainRange(x) ∧ InTexas(x) ∧ HasMine(x) ∧ Donated(x)) ::: There are no mountain ranges in Texas that have mines which have been donated.
Conclusion:
∃x (MountainRange(x) ∧ InTexas(x) ∧ Visited(juan, x)) ::: Juan de Onate visited a mountain range in Texas.
